scope: 30 exposed development queries, 27 code-annotated; 2K/8K budgets; 21 arms; 1 sequential repetition; 1260 timing samples. Code-only Graphify, not documentation or repair quality.
decision_blockers: development workload: the decision rule applies only to the frozen held-out set
Insufficient scored queries: frozen pilot/minimum requires 110 per guardrail
No significant reduction in the primary metric
Too many queries with severe quality losses

primary_diagnostic.hypothesis: candidate delivers fewer tokens than the comparator
primary_diagnostic.test: one-sided paired sign-flip permutation on comparator minus candidate

historical_compatibility.note: Graphify native header contains the per-run scratch graph path; raw outputs retained and compared separately after path normalization.

graphify_budget_note: Requested budgets match; native Graphify overshoots are retained. No equal-realized-budget superiority claim.
cache_conditions: Fresh indexes on identical frozen source sets; index command prebuilds shared units. Sequential tools, fixed arm order for one repeat; shared warm/uncontrolled OS caches. No concurrent comparative work.
timing_scope: Fresh subprocess: startup, index load, query ranking, rendering and stdout. Metadata BM25 creation occurs at query time and is included. No latency inference from one repeat. File-diversity ordering is included in the same query timing boundary. Directed same-file evidence selection and any additional source hydration are included. Baseline packing, helper selection/hydration and total-budget retokenization are included.
source_anchor_recall_for_graphify: not attributed; native output contains hints, not source excerpts

exploratory_source_anchor_diagnostic.scope: Author-selected exposed anchors, all annotated code and documentation; exact range coverage for graf source excerpts only, no Graphify attribution, no task outcome claim
